'''Armored Stormtroopers''', also known as '''Heavy Stormtroopers''', were elite units of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. They are distinguished from other Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] by their heavier armor, orange shoulderpads similar to that of an [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marine]], and a red monocle-like device on their right eye. They were also known to utilize heavy weapons.

During the Battle of the Monstrosa Islands [[Reytha campaign]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a unit of fourteen Armored Stormtroopers was deployed to conquer the islands. Ten more Armored Stormtroopers eventually were assigned to escort three [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] to a small island northwest of the main fortress via a ford.

==Behind the scenes==
Armored Stormtroopers were units that were deployable among the Galactic Empire faction in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as well as its [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion]]. They were upgradable from regular Stormtrooper units. They were able to be created via troop centers used by the Empire.
